Amended - Original Return was filed with OLT

You simply need to login to your OLT ONE account, then click on the year that you need to amend. Sign In to OLT ONE

1

2

You will be taken through your original online interview. Make any changes needed to correct your already filed 1040.

3

When you get to the end of the online interview, you may be asked to enter information as changed by the IRS (If applicable). This will help us compute the Form 1040X for you.

4

Enter the reason for amending your return, then continue to view your updated and amended returns.

5

For tax years 2023, 2024 and 2025 Form 1040 and Form 1040-SR, if the original return was e-filed, the amended return can generally also be e-filed for Federal.

6

We will allow you full access to these forms for 3 years.

Amended Return FAQs

1.Q - Do I need to file an amended tax return?

A - You only need to file an amended tax return if the original return that was accepted by the IRS and/or State needs to be changed.

Example #1

You filed your 1040 to the IRS and it was accepted. The next week you receive another W-2 in the mail. The only way for you to update the originally accepted 1040 with the IRS is to AMEND that tax return and add the income.

Example #2

You filed your 1040 to the IRS claiming yourself and the return was accepted. You later find out your parents were needing to claim you as a dependent on their tax return. For them to now be able to claim you, you will need to AMEND your return indicating you can be claimed on another persons tax return.

2.Q - Can amended returns be e-filed

A - Only Tax Year 2023, 2024 and 2025 1040 and 1040-SR returns can be amended electronically at this time. Amended Returns for any other tax years or tax types must be filed by paper. if the original return was e-filed, in most cases you can e-file the amended return as well for Federal. If amending a prior year return, and the Original return for that year was filed on paper during the current processing year, then the amended return must be filed by paper

3.Q - How long do I have to file an amended return?

A - Generally, to claim a refund, you must file Form 1040-X within 3 years after the date you filed your original return or within 2 years after the date you paid the tax, whichever is later. Returns filed before the due date (without regard to extensions) are considered filed on the due date, and withholding is deemed to be tax paid on the due date. Special rules apply for refund claims relating to net operating losses, foreign tax credits, bad debts, and other issues. For more information, refer to the Instructions for Form 1040-X (PDF)

4.Q - What are some reasons that an amended return cannot be filed electronically with the IRS?

A - Amended returns must be filed by paper for the following reasons:
Any amended Form 1040 and 1040-SR returns older than two years, or Form 1040-NR and 1040-SS returns older than the current year cannot be amended electronically. Amended returns for any other tax years or tax forms must be filed by paper.
If amending a prior year return originally filed on paper, then the amended return must also be filed on paper.

5.Q - How many amended returns can be filed electronically with the IRS?

A - Filers can electronically file up to three amended returns. If you file a third amended return that is accepted, all subsequent attempts will be rejected.

6.Q - How long does it take for an amended return to be processed by the IRS?

A - The current processing time is more than 20 weeks for both paper and electronically filed amended returns. See the IRS operations page for more information about processing timeframes.
Additionally, calling the IRS will not speed up return processing. Their phone and walk-in representatives can only research the status of your amended return 20 weeks or more after you've mailed it; or if Where's My Amended Return? itself has directed you to contact the IRS.

7.Q - How can I check the status of my amended return?

A - The Where's My Amended Return? online tool can be used to check the status of your return and confirm receipt.

On-Line Taxes, Inc. will have no information on the processing of your amended tax return. You may contact the IRS via the link above or call them at (800)-829-1040 to check on the processing of your amended return if beyond 20 weeks. The IRS processes amended returns as quickly as possible however it may take 20 weeks for that amended return to be processed.

8.Q - Is direct deposit available for electronically filed Form 1040-X with the IRS?

A - Direct deposit can't be requested for amended returns. However, there are certain exceptions when a direct deposit may be issued on a Form 1040-X; for example, if there was a math error on your original return.

9.Q - How do I amend my State tax return?

A - To amend your State tax return with On-Line Taxes, Inc. log into your account and go to that tax year. Look under the state summary for the link to amend the return. If you are also amending the federal return, that should be completed first.

If you have any further questions, you may contact our Customer Service for assistance.
